blocks.text: Polarity ki wajah se pani ke molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds bante hain. Hydrogen bonding ki wajah se pani ki specific heat capacity aur heat of vaporisation dono zyada hain. Matlab large bodies of water (bari jheelein, darya, samandar) thermally stable hain: un ka temperature jaldi upar neeche nahi hota.
